description: This Java class, ShoppingCartDataPopulator, is part of a web application for an e-commerce platform. It converts ShoppingCart model objects into ShoppingCartData transfer objects, including details like items, totals, and images, to facilitate data transfer between the backend and frontend layers.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDataPopulator
classes.description: This class extends AbstractDataPopulator and provides methods to convert ShoppingCart objects into ShoppingCartData objects for web presentation, including populating item details, images, totals, and attributes.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ShoppingCartData.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a ShoppingCart object into a ShoppingCartData object by extracting items, images, attributes, and totals, and handling potential ServiceExceptions.

methods.name: getOrderService
methods.description: Returns the ShoppingCartCalculationService used for calculating totals.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the PricingService used for formatting prices.
